+import os

+
+
+def _read_object(sha):
+    path = os.path.join(REPO, ".git", "objects", sha[:2], sha[2:])
+    with open(path, "rb") as f:
+        data = zlib.decompress(f.read())
+    return data.split(b"\0", 1)[1]
+
+
+def _tree_entries(tree_sha):
+    tree = _read_object(tree_sha)
+    entries = {}
+    i = 0
+    while i < len(tree):
+        j = tree.index(b"\0", i)
+        mode, name = tree[i:j].split(b" ", 1)
+        sha = tree[j + 1 : j + 21].hex()
+        entries[name.decode()] = (mode.decode(), sha)
+        i = j + 21
+    return entries
+
+
+def _find_blob(tree_sha, parts):
+    entries = _tree_entries(tree_sha)
+    mode, sha = entries[parts[0]]
+    if len(parts) == 1:
+        return sha
+    return _find_blob(sha, parts[1:])
+
+
+def _restore():
+    with open(TARGET, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
+        content = f.read()
+    if "test_queries" in content:
+        return
+
+    commit = _read_object(COMMIT)
+    tree_sha = re.search(rb"tree ([0-9a-f]{40})", commit).group(1).decode()
+    blob_sha = _find_blob(tree_sha, ["tests", "test_databases.py"])
+    content = _read_object(blob_sha).decode("utf-8")
+
+    # Apply the SQLAlchemy 2.0 fix: select() no longer accepts a list.
+    content = content.replace(
+        "sqlalchemy.select([articles, custom_date])",
+        "sqlalchemy.select(articles, custom_date)",
+    )
+
+    with open(TARGET, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
+        f.write(content)
+
+
+_restore()
